page_title: BOC 1-1 WER | Bochum v Werder Bremen 14/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Bernardo (Bochum) is booked.
90+4' Manuel Riemann (Bochum) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
90+3' 1 - 1 What a fabulous football moment! Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) picks up a nice pass, slams the ball goalwards and his knuckleball glances off the bar into the back of the net.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Thomas Letsch has decided to substitute Christopher Antwi-Adjei and he is replaced by Lukas Daschner (Bochum).
88' A dangerous towering header by Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
87' There's an opportunity for Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
85' A substitution has been made. Jens Stage goes off and Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) comes on.
83' Bochum have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
83' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) will miss the next game.
82' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) picks up a yellow card.

82' Michael Zetterer was forced into action to thwart Philipp Forster (Bochum). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot towards the roof of the net but couldn't beat the keeper. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bochum are going to take it.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) replaces Leonardo Bittencourt.
80' Felix Agu goes off the pitch and Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) comes on.
80' Thomas Letsch decides to make a substitution. Kevin Stoger will be replaced by Philipp Forster (Bochum).
80' It's time for a substitution. Tim Oermann (Bochum) comes on in place of Cristian Gamboa.

77' Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
77' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the corner.

76' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Manuel Riemann easily deals with the threat. Werder Bremen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
75' The referee is firm and issues Anthony Losilla (Bochum) a deserved yellow card.
73' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) replacing Rafael Borre.
73' Justin Njinmah comes off the pitch to be replaced by Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen).
72' Matus Bero (Bochum) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
71' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Manuel Riemann has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
70' A rebound falls at the feet of Matus Bero (Bochum) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar.
70' The attendance is 26000.
70' The corner from Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is intercepted by the defence.
67' Matus Bero (Bochum) controls a great pass from Kevin Stoger on the edge of the box, steadies himself but his poor effort goes yards over the bar.
66' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Stieler and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) comes onto the pitch for Goncalo Paciencia.

64' 1 - 0 Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) scores one of the best goals in his career. His rocket of a shot from distance goes straight into the top right corner. They will be showing this on every football show for some time to come.

62' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
59' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Werder Bremen! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Tobias Stieler and both teams have no complaints.
58' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Werder Bremen! Let's see what he decides.
58' PENALTY APPEAL after Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

58' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the right side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
57' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
55' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle and it's Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
54' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
53' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Bochum are awarded a corner kick.
52' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) touches the ball with his hand.
49' A precise short pass from Christopher Antwi-Adjei releases Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot well past the right post.

49' Michael Zetterer doesn't have to worry about this one. Bernardo plays a pass into the feet of Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the left post.
46' The whistle blows and Tobias Stieler starts the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) offside.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

43' Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) latches onto a precise cross from the free kick and produces a header at goal from the penalty spot, but his attempt towards the roof of the net fails to beat Michael Zetterer, who makes a fine save.
42' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) will miss the next game.
42' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
41' One of the players from Bochum times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
40' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
38' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
37' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle and signals a foul after Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) brought his opponent down. Bochum have a free kick.
35' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) was quite harsh and Tobias Stieler didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
34' Matus Bero (Bochum) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the left side of the goal, but Michael Zetterer pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
33' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
33' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
30' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
28' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bochum was in an offside position.
28' Werder Bremen are ruled offside.
25' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
25' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Stieler had an easy-decision to make.
23' The free kick is taken by Kevin Stoger (Bochum), but ball is cleared.
21' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) brings an opponent down and Tobias Stieler interrupts the game.
17' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
13' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
13' Werder Bremen get a corner. Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
10' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) forces a pass into the box, but Manuel Riemann is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
7' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
6' Matus Bero (Bochum) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
4' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
3' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
3' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) is shown a yellow card by the referee for a bad sliding tackle on an opponent.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Bochum will kick the game off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Tobias Stieler is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
